programmes.d: Ruthless outlaws try to make Marshal Dillon leave Dodge City by threatening to kill a man a day until he departs.
A pair of landgrabbers kill a homesteader's mule and hogs to get his ranch.
Two innocent men seem certain to lose their lives as a result of an old man's wild story.
Kitty gets deserted in a desolate plain by a suitor she rejected.
A rancher's son lets his older brother bear all the blame when they return home after serving a prison sentence for cattle rustling.
A former gunslinger is being bothered by bullies.

A convicted murderer's brother runs against Matt for marshal.

Matt is wounded and taken hostage by a pair of outlaws.
A run on the Dodge City bank forces three desperate farmers to resort to robbery.

Fear of a plague spreads in Dodge City when a private rail coach is quarantined because of a case of spotted fever on board.
Festus Haggen, mistaken for a hired gunman, is offered $300 to fight the three sons of a man his cousin is accused of killing.

Marshal Dillon tracks three robbers from a stagecoach murder holdup while Festus follows Doc on a trip, which leads to near-tragedy.

Parsley Smith, a teller of tall tales, claims the new town banker is plotting to make off with the depositors' money.

A 17-year-old boy's premature efforts to become a man involve him in robbery and murder.
